questions.q: Who was Ram Baksh Singh?
questions.answer: Ram Baksh Singh was a bais suryavanshi Rajput who was the Raja Rao of Daundia Khera of Unnao district Uttar Pradesh in the then Oudh province.

questions.q: What role did Ram Baksh Singh play in the Sepoy Mutiny?
questions.answer: He was one of the leaders of the Sepoy Mutiny and a close associate of Nana Sahib.

questions.q: When and by whom was Ram Baksh Singh hanged?
questions.answer: He was hanged by the British on 28 December 1857.

questions.q: What did the Government of India do in 1992 regarding Ram Baksh Singh?
questions.answer: The Government of India built a memorial at the place where he was hanged to honor his death.

questions.q: What structures are part of the remains of Ram Baksh Singh's fort?
questions.answer: The remains include the ruins of his royal mansion, a huge campus spread over hundreds of acres, a temple to Shiva in use for more than 180 years, and various other structures.

questions.q: Why has the site of Ram Baksh Singh's fort been in the news recently?
questions.answer: It has been in the news due to an excavation for gold by the Archaeological Survey of India.
